title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Customer and Insurer Terms: Payer Agreement and Scheduling of the Calibration
content:
**Payer agreement.** No attempt on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order starts until the payer has agreed to the calibration.

**Insurance claim repairs.** For an order paid through an insurance claim repair, the calibration is approved on that repair order, on the original estimate or by an approved supplement that includes calibration. Where the tier requires the insurer's approval of the calibration on the repair order, a calibration not on the original estimate waits for that supplement's approval; the network never performs it first and bills later.

**Glass programs.** A glass-program order rests on the glass claim job itself.

**Customer-pay orders.** A customer-pay order rests on the customer's acceptance of the tier's calibration price — this clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis on which a customer-pay order's agreement rests.

**Scheduling.** Calibrations are scheduled at least the tier's scheduling notice in business days ahead, mobile only where the tier offers mobile calibration, and the customer may wait where the tier allows the customer to wait at the center.

## How the insurer's approval is established

- The approval is read from the network's records of the insurance claim repair order the calibration order is paid through: whether the calibration order is recorded as included in the insurer-authorized original estimate, and, for that same repair order, its supplements that include calibration and the decision recorded on each.
- The records are read before an attempt starts; the agreement must stand at that point.

## Agreement by payer

| Payer of the order | What the payer's agreement rests on |
|---|---|
| Insurer, through an insurance claim repair | The calibration on the original estimate, or an approved supplement on that repair order that includes calibration |
| Insurer's glass program | The glass claim job itself |

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Calibration on the original estimate | Supplement on the same repair order that includes calibration | Approval on the repair order |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | approved (on the original estimate) |
| no | approved | approved (by the supplement) |
| no | submitted, no approval yet | not yet: the calibration waits for the supplement's approval |
| no | none | not approved |

superseded_clauses: a customer-pay order on the customer's acceptance of calibration_price_usd
